name: tournament-evolve
notes: K candidates → rank → evolve → meta-review (T5, co-scientist-lite). For open-ended design. Candidates are new files, never edits of a parent; the meta-review appends lessons to the shared notes and never rewrites them. The ranker claims route:plateau when the best has not improved for two rounds.

nodes.task:
{goal}

Propose ONE new candidate (you are {copy}). Read the lessons in the shared notes first and do not repeat anything already listed there. Write it to candidates/round-{round}-gen-{copy}.md.

Rank every candidate in {prev_artifacts} against the goal, comparing similar ones first and swapping the order of each pair. Write the ranking with reasons to candidates/ranking-round-{round}.md. Claim `route:plateau` if the best has not improved on the last round's best, otherwise claim done.

Goal: {goal}

From the top of the latest ranking (in {prev_artifacts}), make ONE new candidate: combine two, simplify one, or fix the weakest point of the best. Never edit a parent. Write candidates/round-{round}-evolve-{copy}.md.
Read this round's rankings and candidates ({prev_artifacts}). Append 3-5 dated lessons to the shared notes: what wins, what keeps losing. Do not rewrite old lines. Claim done.
